episodes.name: Adventures of a Normal Man (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Secret alien Clark Kent and his best friend Jimmy Olsen start their internship at The Daily Planet and meet fellow intern Lois Lane - who ropes them into investigating stolen military robots threatening Metropolis!
episodes.overviewAr: يبدأ الفضائي المتخفي 'كلارك كينت" وصديقه المفضل "جيمي أولسن" فترة تدريبهما في صحيفة الـ "ديلي بلانيت"، وهناك يلتقيان بزميلتهما المتدربة "لويس لين"، التي تورطهما في تحقيق حول روبوتات عسكرية مسروقة تهدد مدينة متروبوليس!

episodes.name: Adventures of a Normal Man (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Clark returns to the Kent farm with questions about where he's from - and who he wants to be. Meanwhile, Lois and Jimmy track down the mercenary Livewire…and encounter "Superman" once again!
episodes.overviewAr: يعود "كلارك" إلى مزرعة عائلة "كينت" حاملًا تساؤلات حول أصوله، والشخص الذي يطمح أن يكونه. في هذه الأثناء، تتعقب "لويس" و"جيمي" المرتزقة "لايف واير"... ويصادفان "سوبرمان" مرة أخرى!

episodes.name: My Interview with Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Lois wants to interview Superman for The Daily Planet, and Clark must figure out how to help her while protecting his identity! The criminal ring INTERGANG gets their hands on weapons, and a mysterious organization plots in the shadows...
episodes.overviewAr: ترغب "لويس" في إجراء مقابلة مع "سوبرمان" لصالح الـ "ديلي بلانيت"، ويجب على "كلارك" اكتشاف طريقة لمساعدتها مع الحفاظ على سرية هويته! وفي الوقت نفسه، تضع عصابة "إنترغانغ" الإجرامية أيديها على أسلحة خطيرة، بينما تحيك منظمة غامضة مؤامراتها في الخفاء...

episodes.name: Let's Go to Ivo Tower, You Say
episodes.nameAr: فلنذهب إلى برج إيفو، كما تقول
episodes.overviewEn: Clark, Lois, and Jimmy cover a glitzy gala hosted by tech-billionaire Dr. Ivo - but while Clark and Lois wonder if this counts as a date, Ivo unleashes his newest invention: a creation that can bring down Superman!
episodes.overviewAr: يقوم "كلارك" و"لويس" و"جيمي" بتغطية حفل مبهر يستضيفه الملياردير في مجال التكنولوجيا الدكتور "إيفو". ولكن بينما يتساءل "كلارك" و"لويس" عما إذا كان هذا يُعد موعداً غرامياً، يطلق "إيفو" العنان لأحدث اختراعاته: سلاح قادر على القضاء على "سوبرمان"!

episodes.name: You Will Believe a Man Can Lie
episodes.nameAr: سوف تُصدق أن رجلًا يمكنه أن يكذب
episodes.overviewEn: Lois uncovers a secret in Metropolis and is determined to get to the truth. Meanwhile, Superman tracks down dangerous weapons in the city…and finds himself in the crosshairs of mysterious organization Task Force X.
episodes.overviewAr: تكتشف "لويس" سراً في متروبوليس وتُصمم على الوصول إلى الحقيقة. في هذه الأثناء، يتعقب "سوبرمان" أسلحة خطيرة في المدينة... ويجد نفسه في مرمى نيران المنظمة الغامضة "فرقة العمل إكس".

episodes.name: My Adventures with Mad Science
episodes.overviewEn: When Jimmy gets kidnapped, it's up to Lois and Clark to save him - but rescuing Jimmy will lead them into danger as they deal with mad scientists, military secrets, and relationship woes!
episodes.overviewAr: عندما يتعرض "جيمي" للاختطاف، يقع على عاتق "لويس" و"كلارك" إنقاذه. لكن عملية الإنقاذ ستقودهما إلى الخطر أثناء تعاملهما مع علماء مجانين، وأسرار عسكرية، ومشاكل عاطفية!

episodes.name: Kiss Kiss Fall in Portal
episodes.overviewEn: Clark tries to plan a normal date without any Superman problems - but gets interrupted when Mr. Mxyzptlk sweeps him, Jimmy, and Lois into a high-stakes, multiverse-hopping chase!
episodes.overviewAr: يحاول "كلارك" التخطيط لموعد غرامي طبيعي خالٍ من مشاكل "سوبرمان"، لكن خطته تتعطل عندما يسحبه السيد "مكسيزبتلك" هو و"جيمي" و"لويس" في مطاردة عالية المخاطر تتنقل بهم عبر الأكوان المتعددة!

episodes.name: Zero Day (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Lois meets her journalism idol, Vicki Vale - only for Vicki to make Lois question her loyalty to Superman. Meanwhile, Superman hunts down Task Force X while dealing with a new power!
episodes.overviewAr: تلتقي "لويس" بمثلها الأعلى في الصحافة، "فيكي فيل"، لكن سرعان ما تجعل "فيكي" "لويس" تشكك في ولائها لـ "سوبرمان". في هذه الأثناء، يطارد "سوبرمان" "فرقة العمل إكس" بينما يتعلم السيطرة على قوة جديدة لديه!

episodes.name: Zero Day (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Superman finally gets answers to who he is and where he came from, while coming face-to-face with THE GENERAL, leader of Task Force X. Meanwhile, Lois and Jimmy must find Superman before DR. IVO destroys Metropolis!
episodes.overviewAr: يحصل "سوبرمان" أخيرًا على إجابات حول هويته والمكان الذي جاء منه، وذلك حينما يواجه "الجنرال"، قائد "فرقة العمل إكس". وفي الوقت نفسه، يجب على "لويس" و"جيمي" العثور على "سوبرمان" قبل أن يدمر الدكتور "إيفو" مدينة متروبوليس!

episodes.name: Hearts of the Fathers
episodes.overviewEn: It's Thanksgiving, and Clark, Lois, and Jimmy are heading to the Kent farm to celebrate - but the holiday turns into a fight for survival as Task Force X, family, and Kryptonite collide!
episodes.overviewAr: يحل عيد الشكر، ويتجه "كلارك" و"لويس" و"جيمي" إلى مزرعة "كينت" للاحتفال. لكن العطلة تتحول إلى معركة من أجل البقاء عندما تتصادم "فرقة العمل إكس"، وقضايا العائلة، ومادة "الكريبتونيت" القاتلة!

episodes.name: More Things in Heaven and Earth
episodes.overviewEn: Clark agonizes over what to do for his and Lois' first Valentine's Day…until visions of his father lead him, Jimmy, and Lois to the remains of his Spaceship and the new villains of Task Force X!

episodes.name: Adventures with My Girlfriend
episodes.overviewEn: While Perry saddles Jimmy with a new "team" to run Flamebird, Clark and Lois investigate Stryker Penitentiary - and discover just how far Amanda Waller will go to rid the world of Superman!

episodes.name: Fullmetal Scientist
episodes.overviewEn: Clark's life falls apart as The General goes into hiding…in Clark's apartment! Meanwhile, Jimmy struggles with being a leader, and Lois goes toe-to-toe with Vicki Vale as they track down missing scientists!

episodes.name: Two Lanes Diverged
episodes.overviewEn: When Jimmy is invited to speak at the S.T.A.R. Labs Symposium, Clark is happy to come along as support ... until Lex Luthor takes over! Meanwhile, The General goes on the run -- and Lois runs after him, visions of their past clashing with the present.

episodes.name: Most Eligible Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Lois and Clark's relationship is pushed to the breaking point when Superman is named Metropolis' most eligible bachelor! Meanwhile, Jimmy gives a cute girl a tour of the city…a girl on a mission to find her long-lost cousin…

episodes.name: The Machine Who Would Be Empire
episodes.overviewEn: Kidnapped and far from home, Superman bonds with his cousin Kara…and discovers the truth about Krypton from the last Kryptonians in existence!

episodes.name: Olsen's Eleven
episodes.overviewEn: Lois and Jimmy recruit mercenaries and mad scientists to help them steal a spaceship out from under the nose of Task Force X!

episodes.name: The Death of Clark Kent
episodes.overviewEn: Lois and Jimmy confront Kara and make a plan to rescue Clark. Meanwhile, Brainiac delves into Superman's mind to figure out what makes him tick…and how to tear him apart!

episodes.name: Pierce the Heavens, Superman!
episodes.overviewEn: Jimmy and Kara race back to Metropolis to stop Brainiac's invasion of Earth! Meanwhile, Lois tries to free Clark from Brainiac's control, only to lose herself in an alternate reality where Superman never left Krypton…

episodes.name: My Adventures with Supergirl
episodes.overviewEn: Superman, Kara, Lois and Jimmy team up to fight Brainiac, but will Superman have to choose between saving Earth and saving the people he loves? It's truth, justice and a better way clashing with the might of Krypton!

episodes.name: Into the New World
episodes.overviewEn: Lois and her dad ruin Halloween. Kara likes Jimmy. Superman makes a friend. The gang has a bizarre adventure.

episodes.name: Mobile Suit Toyman
episodes.overviewEn: Big things happen at the Super Convention. Kara takes a friend's advice. Clark gets Whipped. Lois Chases a story. Jimmy makes a mistake.

episodes.name: All's Fair in Love and W.O.R.M.S.
episodes.overviewEn: Jimmy is changed by a big date. Kara gets on the apps. Lois sings the blues. Superman destroys Clark's Saturday.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Slammin' to Dinner?
episodes.overviewEn: Clark and Lois get poundcake. A stranger comes to brunch. Jimmy gets to be right. Hank shakes things up at Lexcorp.

episodes.name: The Death of Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Superman tries to save the City. Our heroes try to save Superman.

episodes.name: Party Animals
episodes.overviewEn: The gang goes to a charity gala. Lois tries to win. Clark tries to help. Jimmy's date makes a scene. Kara cleans it up.

episodes.name: The Ex-Games
episodes.overviewEn: Lois, Jimmy and Kara and Clark play games with Lois, Jimmy, Kara, and Lex. Everyone hates it. A divorce ends in deception.

episodes.name: It's Reigning (Super)Men
episodes.overviewEn: Clark and Lois face the future -- again. Familiar faces return to Metropolis. Lex shakes things up at Lexcorp.

episodes.name: Vae Victis
episodes.overviewEn: Clark struggles against Krypton's past. Lois struggles against Earth's future. Various children misbehave. Jimmy yells at Lex.

episodes.name: The Return
episodes.overviewEn: Our heroes try to save the world. Clark tries to reach them. Lex faces the music. It's time to be brave.
